line_text: Gibbs How long are we going to be out here, sir? With Leviathan and her fleet sunk, I couldn't help but wonder if we should— / Deweg Desert our post? The Empire doesn't look kindly upon deserters, Gibbs! / Gibbs Of-Of course not! But our commanders did go down with the others in jagd. If we don't receive new orders, we're like to stand watch here till our armor rusts! I thought we might find a way to transfer to a new division. / Deweg You want to end up fighting on the front lines? / Gibbs N-No sir! Only, it's so...boring here. / Deweg A proper soldier never leaves his post until he's relieved. If that means staying until your dying day, so be it. More like you'll be shipped off to battle long before that, though. / Gibbs Fair enough, sir, but why'd it have to be here? Here of all places? / Deweg A soldier doesn't complain about his post, Gibbs. Granted it's hot...the city reeks of sweat...and I've sand in places sand has no right to be. And I'll never get the stink of chocobo out of my nose. / Deweg That reminds me. The ones at Lord Vayne's appointment ceremony...a gift of your family, weren't they? / Gibbs I'd hoped to forget. The fewer what know about that, the better. / Deweg What's to be ashamed of? You ought to be proud. Your family raises some of the finest in the Empire. / Finest what? Sorry to say I couldn't attend the appointment ceremony... This place does stink, and no mistake. Better finish my work here and be off. Can't go back to Archades smelling like this.

Thanks to my family, I smelled so strongly of chocobo, the first time I went to the capital the women wouldn't give me the time of day. I had to save up for months to buy a viera cologne to mask the stench before I was able to find someone who'd marry me. If I come back stinking of chocobo, she'll leave me for a certainty! line_text: Many of our young men died defending their homeland in the war two years ago. Right here at Nalbina Fortress, they were slain. ...So too the King and Lord Rasler. Yet now this place is a base for the Archadian armies. They have gathered labor to fortify the town in preparation for Rozarrian attack.

speaker: Nalbinite
line_text: Many of our young men died defending their homeland in the war two years ago. Right here at Nalbina Fortress, they were slain. Yet now this place is a base for the Archadian armies. They have gathered labor to fortify the town in preparation for Rozarrian attack.

speaker: Nalbinite
line_text: You here to help 'em shore up the walls, too? Or maybe to find work with the watch? Been a steady stream since they upped the wages. Tch. Is this our fate as Dalmascans? Working to rebuild our own fortress for the Archadians...

speaker: Itinerant Hand
line_text: Mosphoran Highwaste's just a ways down this road. Make your way across the Highwaste and you'll come out in the Salikawood. I'm quite fond of the starfruits you can find there. Now that the blockade is down, I'm hopin' Adair's Caravan will bring some to town.
I work to earn money to buy my daughter medicine. Please, buy something.

speaker: Gurdy
line_text: Kupo? You've already hired a chocobo. One to a customer, that's our policy, kupo! / Kupo-po? What's this...? You haven't enough gil? Perhaps some other time, kupo! / You—you've an unusual companion in your party. It's apt to scare the chocobos. I'm sorry, but I'll have to ask you to come back without...it, kupo. / What's that? You've not ridden a chocobo? Not to worry! Just be mindful that you've a limited amount of time for your ride, kupo! Off you go now! Quite a treat, watching the world fly by from your perch in the saddle, kupo! / Splendid! Safe travels, kupo! / Perhaps another day, kupo. Should you ever need a chocobo, you know where to find one!

line_text: I already heard from one of the caravans come in before you. Sounds like you made short work of that atomos. The caravans shouldn't have any trouble bringin' supplies through the mountains now. You've my thanks, boy! / Hey there! Jovy! / You're grinnin' ear to ear, Burrogh. What's this hubbub about? / This here boy did fer that atomos! Who said there weren't no heroes in Nalbina! / (snort) / Was it somethin' I said? Sorry, didn't mean to keep you so long. Thanks again fer takin' care of that atomos fer me. Here's yer bounty, boy. You earned every gil.

trigger: requested by 依頼人ポポル.talk_q152_step04
line_text: You're back! Thank you so much for helping me! I couldn't keep my eyes open any longer...I fell asleep. The deathscythe was there, as always, but then it just...vanished! I knew then that you had killed it. Ah, to be awake again! When you're haunted by a death- scythe, you're never really awake. Before the war, me and a friend of mine had a smithy...but he's gone now. Who knows...maybe it's time I gave that another try. / Well, if it isn't Jovy! Jovy, over here! / What do you want, Popol? If you're still trying to get rid of that cursed axe of yours, I'm not interested. / The cursed axe is cursed no more! This fellow killed the spirit that had been haunting me! / (snort) / Well, that's Jovy for you... / I can never thank you enough. You saved me from a fate worse than...well, a deadly fate at any rate. Thank you!

line_text: Say there, you know 'bout gambits? Well, see, they're like...well, they're here. Take a look. ...Sorry, I'd best brush up on my wares 'fore I cry them. Come back later and I'll give it another try, eh?

speaker: Morning Star Gambits
line_text: Never shoulda opened my shop in this heat. Buy something, will ya?
Shop's closed till the consul's appointed in Rabanastre.
Eh heh heh... I got lots o' things here...none of which I'm at leave to talk about in public, if you know what I mean. Eh heh heh... No?
Shop's closed till the consul's appointed in Rabanastre.
Come one, come all! Magicks straight from the lost city of Nabudis! I've got the connections that make lesser magickers green, no magick necessary! Take a look at my wares! They speak for themselves!

speaker: Merchant
line_text: We first opened shop in Nabudis... And lost all but our lives when the Empire turned our home to dust. Good thing we'd the sense to evacuate! Me and my bangaa associate, he managed to get the shop open again. Now we do good business, selling to the Empire!

speaker: Merchant
line_text: Nestled as it is on the border of Nabradia and Dalmasca, Nalbina was always bustling with trade between the two. These days it's more fortress than town. At least it's still here, though. Our home of Nabudis was wiped from the land, leaving naught but a necrohol of fiends behind.

speaker: Merchant
line_text: The Imperial army's gearing up for something big. Airships full to overflowing with soldiers fly in, and work on the fortress never stops. Sure, merchants are happy. War is good business. Our shop, too, does well...yet I look upon our success with a troubled heart.

speaker: Itinerant Hand
line_text: Come to help fortify the fortress? The wages aren't bad, aye, but it's hard work. 'Specially for someone as slim as yourself. Still they come. I've been working here since the beginning, so I've seen 'em all.

speaker: Itinerant Hand
line_text: Come to help fortify the fortress? You shouldn't have it too bad. They save the easy jobs for the humes. Me? I get sent off to do the heavy lifting. Those Imperials think the rest of us are to be used as tools, nothing more. Nice, eh?

speaker: Itinerant Hand
line_text: Some days they say the Rozarrians are coming, others, the Resistance. They keep fortifying the walls to be ready. Day and night, day and night. 'Cept the humes! They get rest days! Tch. Those Imperials think the rest of us are to be used as tools, nothing more. Nice, eh?

speaker: Itinerant Hand
line_text: Fun to check out the stalls between jobs. Peddlers making all sorts of outlandish claims. "My simples would cure Emperor Gramis himself!"

speaker: Itinerant Hand
line_text: A lot of Imperials buy keepsakes here before heading home. The viera crafts are particularly popular. 'Course, the seeq in back makes 'em. Heh.

speaker: Itinerant Hand
line_text: I'm tired of bricklaying, thought I'd join the army. 'Course, they only take humes. Everyone else gets used for works, or cannon fodder.

speaker: Itinerant Hand
line_text: Say, you know of the baknamy? A violent, greedy lot, them. I hear they've made the Nabreus Deadlands their territory. That deathland is a fitting place for their ilk.

speaker: Itinerant Hand
line_text: It's tough work, under tough eyes. Pah. Food and break time's all I have to look forward to.

speaker: Itinerant Hand
line_text: Them Archadians were all talking, and they didn't look happy. Heard something about the Leviathan and her 8th Fleet goin' down! Took some important Judge down with it, too, from the sounds of it. Heh. Serves 'em right.

speaker: Itinerant Hand
line_text: My home, the Republic of Landis...you won't find it on any map. The Empire's to thank for that. I ran from Landis to Nabradia, and when Nabradia was attacked I fled here, to Nalbina...and war followed me again. Where next!?

speaker: Nalbinite
line_text: They say a horrible creature that lost a war with the gods lurks even now in the Mosphoran Highwaste. 'Tis a local legend.

speaker: Nalbinite
line_text: The local lore is built on stories from many lands, what with the traffic a border town like Nalbina sees.

speaker: Itinerant Hand
line_text: You heard of the Barheim Passage? Legend says you can hear the eerie cry of a woman from the depths of that accursed place. Boss Burrogh knew this and still he went, that crazy bangaa... He's down there now, scavenging for junk to restore and sell.

speaker: Imperial
line_text: They came here to work and earn a good wage rebuilding the fortress, and now they complain! I've had enough of these people.

speaker: Imperial
line_text: Here to work on the fortress? A word to the wise: complain overmuch and you'll be thrown in the dungeons, from which there can be no escape! ...Huh? You heard of someone escaping? Bah! Nonsense!

speaker: Imperial
line_text: We pay good wages, and still they complain! Can't anyone work in silence anymore?

speaker: Itinerant Hand
line_text: I came here to work on restoring the fortress, but it's soooo hot! I can't work in these conditions! If we're to work out here, we need good coin. That's what my bangaa friend here's negotiating for.

speaker: Itinerant Hand
line_text: We're here working on the fortress walls, but it's torture in this heat... That's why we're negotiating for better pay! They say that any who complain'll be sent to the dungeons, but that's a bluff. They're in a hurry— they need all the hands they can get!

speaker: Itinerant Hand
line_text: They raised the amount they give to us laborers, but the work's gotten that much more difficult. War's got them all in a rush to build. Even if we get twice the coin, what good's it do us if we have to do three times the work!?

speaker: Shy Bangaa
line_text: Wh-What...? I'm just watchin' these goods, like always... Hey, no stealin', you hear?

speaker: Shy Bangaa
line_text: ...I'm here, watchin' these goods. For hours. You know, I just noticed, a lot of these Imperials are armed! Yeah, observant, right? That's my job.

speaker: Shy Bangaa
line_text: I've been watching these goods for hours. The one what owns 'em hasn't come back from wherever he went. How long do I got to wait here?

speaker: Itinerant Hand
line_text: Far to the east lies a port town where sky pirates gather. I'll be one, someday, and that's where I'll ago. Just need to make some gil first.

speaker: Itinerant Hand
line_text: I'm headed to that port in the east, where the sky pirates gather. Once I've earned me a 'ship, I'll be a sky pirate, free to go where I will!

speaker: Itinerant Hand
line_text: You ever been to Balfonheim? That's where I'm headed. Made myself a good pile of gil. I'll be a sky pirate 'fore you know it!

speaker: Homebound Man
line_text: I came out here from Rabanastre to earn some gil to make my wife and child happy...but I can't take this hard labor no more... Hi, honey. It's me...the failure. (sigh)

speaker: Homebound Man
line_text: I hear conditions in Rabanastre have improved while I've been here in Nalbina. Must be on account of that new consul.

speaker: Homebound Man
line_text: I finally got used to the work, and they even raised our wages, but I think I'll go home to my family, to Rabanastre. If war's coming like they say it will, I should be with my wife and child...or I'll die out here alone. A failure to the end. (sigh)
